title: Spaghetti Carbonara
description: Classic Roman pasta with eggs, Pecorino Romano, guanciale, and black pepper.
steps: Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente.
Fry guanciale in a dry pan until crispy.
Whisk egg yolks, whole egg, and Pecorino together.
Reserve 1 cup pasta water, drain pasta.
Toss pasta with guanciale off heat.
Add egg mixture and pasta water, toss until creamy.
Season with black pepper and serve immediately.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
description: Tender marinated chicken in a rich, spiced tomato-cream sauce.
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices for 1 hour.
Grill or broil chicken until charred, then cube.
Sauté onion in butter until golden.
Add garlic and ginger, cook 2 min.
Add spices and tomatoes, simmer 15 min.
Blend sauce until smooth.
Add cream and chicken, simmer 10 min.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with rice or naan.

title: Avocado Toast with Poached Eggs
description: Creamy smashed avocado on sourdough topped with perfectly poached eggs and chilli flakes.
steps: Toast sourdough until golden.
Smash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Bring a pot of water to a gentle simmer, add vinegar.
Crack eggs into separate cups.
Swirl water and slide eggs in, poach 3 min.
Spread avocado on toast.
Top with poached eggs, chilli flakes, and a drizzle of olive oil.

title: Beef Tacos
description: Juicy seasoned ground beef in crispy taco shells with fresh toppings.
steps: Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Brown ground beef, breaking it up.
Drain excess fat.
Add spices and 1/4 cup water, simmer 3 min.
Warm taco shells in oven at 180°C for 5 min.
Fill shells with beef and desired toppings.
Serve with lime wedges.

title: Lemon Garlic Roast Chicken
description: Whole roast chicken with crispy golden skin, infused with lemon and garlic.
steps: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels.
Mix softened butter with thyme, rosemary, salt, and pepper.
Rub butter mixture under and over the skin.
Stuff cavity with halved lemon and crushed garlic.
Roast for 1 hour 20 min until juices run clear.
Rest 10 min before carving.

title: Classic Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: Crispy edges, chewy centres, loaded with chocolate chips.
steps: Preheat oven to 190°C.
Brown butter in a saucepan until nutty, then cool.
Whisk butter with sugars until combined.
Beat in eggs and vanilla.
Fold in flour, baking soda, and salt.
Stir in chocolate chips.
Scoop dough onto lined baking sheet.
Bake 10-12 min until edges are golden.
Cool on tray for 5 min.

title: Mushroom Risotto
description: Creamy Arborio rice slowly cooked with porcini and mixed mushrooms.
steps: Soak porcini in hot water 20 min, reserve soaking liquid.
Warm stock in a separate pot.
Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil.
Add fresh mushrooms and porcini, cook until soft.
Add rice and toast 2 min.
Pour in wine and stir until absorbed.
Add stock ladle by ladle, stirring constantly.
Finish with butter and Parmesan.
Season and serve immediately.

title: Greek Salad
description: Crisp cucumber, ripe tomatoes, Kalamata olives, and creamy feta with a simple oregano dressing.
steps: Chop tomatoes and cucumber into large chunks.
Thinly slice red onion.
Combine tomatoes, cucumber, onion, and olives in a bowl.
Whisk olive oil, vinegar, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Pour dressing over salad.
Top with crumbled feta.
Serve immediately.
